# Everything about the Enclave Plasma Rifle/Pistol and mods

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_76_nukaknights-post-enclave-plasma-rifle.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update 12/5/2023]** The mods are now almost all available individually **[Update 10/10/2023]** Flamethrower barrels are now counted as command perks

Enclave plasma rifles (and pistols) have become even more popular since you can roll them with legendary effects. EPR (Enclave Plasma Rifle) or EPG (Enclave Plasma Rifle) are often used as abbreviations here. These weapons have higher base damage than normal plasma rifles and pistols, but there are some special features that make them even more interesting.

## Special features of the Enclave Plasma Rifles and Pistols

- Higher base damage than normal plasma rifles/pistols
- Tradeable (weapon and mods)
- **No blueprint for the weapon**
- **No blueprint for mods**
- No way to learn the mods by scrapping them
- Weapon can drop at events (chance of matching mods)
- Weapon can be bought in Mode in the Whitespring Bunker (chance of matching mods)
- Mods can be purchased from some merchant bots with a low chance
- Mods have a small chance of dropping as rewards during events
- Mods have a low chance of being found loose
- Ammunition: Plasma cartridges or UItrazit plasma cartridges
- Noise class: **Loud** (there is no silencer)
At events or in situations where you are already discovered, the Enclave Plasma is easy to play even without a stealth bonus and does a lot of damage. In the open field you can also play stealthily and get the covert operations bonus if the opponents are far away.

## Enclave Plasma weapon drops and dealer offers

During **Enclave events** "**Lost Connection**" there is a **30% chance** of an Enclave Plasma Rifle or Enclave Plasma Pistol as a reward (100% chance of non-standard mods). During these events, if you get an Enclave Plasma Rifle or Pistol dropped, you also have a chance of getting one with **Reflex Sight**. You'll need a reflex sight if you want to optimize for VATS and legendary roll a good version of the EPR. There is no chance of these drops at the other enclave events.

In **mode in the Whitespring Bunker** (at the production terminal) you can also buy Enclave plasma rifles and pistols with non-standard mods e.g. reflex sights with **10% chance**. The chance is significantly lower than at events, but it doesn't hurt to check what's on offer every now and then, maybe you'll get lucky.

In the main quest "**One of Us**" you also have the chance to get an Enclave Plasma Rifle.

And the Burnt Enclave Officers in the **Enclave Research Factory** can actually also drop Enclave Rifles as loot.

**Almost all of the mods are now also available individually as box mods.**

## Enclave Plasma Mods

- Closure: Changeable, mods available
- Run: Changeable, mods available
- Piston: Changeable, mods available
- Visor: Changeable, mods available, for VATS builds you need a reflex visor (as -15% VATS action point costs)
- Wrap: Poker Wrap (Season 15)

As already mentioned, you should have an EPR with a reflex sight as a basis that you can continue to build on. Here you can now farm mods or buy them from other players in vending machines.

You can find the **Mods** with a chance (0.081%-0.163%) randomly and individually at the following retailers:

- Watoga Station (the adjusted flamethrower barrel is only available in Watoga)
- Watoga Shopping Center (Phoenix) (the adjusted flamethrower barrel is only available in Watoga)
- R&G station
- Pleasant Valley Station
- Pleasant Valley Resort
-Berkeley Springs Station
- Sunnytop Station

The offers from these dealer bots change for you every time you change servers. So you can do server hopping
